CustomField.label: Draft Position
CustomField.description: The League Member Draft Order value who should make this pick, accounting for snake order. Odd rounds count up (1→12), even rounds count down (12→1). The draftBoard LWC uses this to auto-assign the drafter.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Shows the draft order slot (1–12) of the team who owns this pick.
